audit_items.proof_trace: The /health handler (L38-65) is unauthenticated and directly includes `client.ws.status` as `discord.ws_status` (L41, L55) and raw Discord API exception messages as `discord.guild_error` (L49, L59) in the JSON response. Proof fails at both fields: neither is filtered or omitted for unauthenticated callers.
audit_items.attack_scenario: An unauthenticated attacker sends GET /health and receives `discord.ws_status` (internal Discord.js WebSocket state enum), `discord.guild_id`, `discord.bot_user` tag, and `discord.guild_error` (raw Discord API error text), revealing real-time bot connection state and internal error details without any credential requirement.
